symbols.title: Financial Symbols / Tickers
symbols.description: List of tickers to analyze (e.g. SPY, QQQ, GC=F, XAUUSD, BTC-USD, EURUSD, CPI, DGS10). Supports Stocks, ETFs, Forex, Commodities, Crypto, and FRED Macro Series.

dataProvider.title: Data Provider / Source
dataProvider.description: Choose preferred market data source. 'auto' automatically selects the source with the longest historical track record.

yearsBack.title: Years to Analyze (0 for All-Time)
yearsBack.description: Number of recent historical years to include in the seasonality calculations. Set 0 for the entire available historical dataset.

seasonalPeriods.title: Cumulative Seasonal Periods (Years)
seasonalPeriods.description: Custom lookback periods to calculate average seasonal trajectories (e.g., [5, 10, 15, 20]).

includeMonthlyMatrix.title: Include Full Monthly Matrix (Year x Month)
includeMonthlyMatrix.description: Whether to return the complete historical monthly return table for each calendar year.

includeProbabilities.title: Include Win Rates & Probabilities
includeProbabilities.description: Calculate Day-of-the-Week (Mon-Fri) and Quarterly (Q1-Q4) win rates and return distributions.

includeDailyCurves.title: Include Daily Cumulative Seasonal Trajectories
includeDailyCurves.description: Return normalized day-by-day average cumulative return curves for multi-period seasonal charting.
